name: Mor Kuzhambu
steps: Soak chana dal and rice for 20 minutes, then drain. Grind with coconut, cumin, green chilli and 100 ml of the measured water to a smooth paste.
Peel and deseed the ash gourd and cut into small cubes. Simmer with 250 ml water, turmeric and salt for 10–12 minutes until translucent and easily pierced.
Add the ground paste and simmer for 4 minutes, stirring to cook the soaked rice and dal. Whisk the curd separately with the remaining 100 ml water until smooth.
Turn the heat to its lowest setting and stir in the curd. Heat gently for 3–4 minutes, stirring, until steaming; do not allow a rolling boil or the curd may split.
Heat coconut oil in a small pan, pop mustard seeds and add dried chilli and curry leaves carefully. Pour over the curry, cover briefly and serve with separately cooked rice.
passiveTime: Soak rice and chana dal for 20 minutes.
notes: Base recipe for 4 adults. Cooking times are estimates; follow the texture and doneness cues. Jain suitability follows your saved ingredient choices.
